status: Editable design concepts; interactions are proposed, not four implemented prototypes.
source: One supplied screenshot excerpt from coderabbitai/mono #22041. Same source content used across all four directions. Missing files, code, and original comments are not reconstructed.

concepts.name: Focus Desk
concepts.idea: Full-width code with an explanation dock.
concepts.interaction: Move between layers above the diff; choose a summary in the bottom dock. Collapse the dock for uninterrupted code reading.
concepts.strength: Keeps more code visible during sustained inspection.
concepts.tradeoff: Explanations sit farther from the selected lines.

concepts.name: Review Notebook
concepts.idea: Read the explanation, then its code, with comments in the margin.
concepts.interaction: Each explanation precedes its source excerpt. Expand the full diff when you need more context; keep notes beside the relevant section.
concepts.strength: Makes the reasoning and evidence easy to follow in sequence.
concepts.tradeoff: Adds vertical reading and can become long on large PRs.

concepts.name: Dependency Lens
concepts.idea: Use the relationship between layers as the review navigation.
concepts.interaction: Select a layer in the dependency view to inspect its code. The connector shows the known depends-on relationship.
concepts.tradeoff: A map needs enough verified relationship data to earn its space.

concepts.name: Evidence Queue
concepts.idea: Select one change, inspect its evidence, and move to the next.
concepts.interaction: The change list drives a single evidence pane. N/P moves between changes; J/K retains layer navigation. File viewed status stays separate.
concepts.strength: Provides a deliberate, guided pass through the change.
concepts.tradeoff: A checklist can obscure the wider file context unless the full diff remains accessible.
